just.snippet:
# Lint with eslint.
node-lint:
    npx --yes eslint . --max-warnings=0

# Auto-format with prettier.
node-fmt:
    npx --yes prettier --write .

# Verify formatting without modifying files (for CI).
node-fmt-check:
    npx --yes prettier --check .
